dimensions.score_0: No persistent queue receipt; draft/chat text is misrepresented as delivery.
dimensions.score_1: Queue and receipt exist but no real browser confirmation or reliable readback.
dimensions.score_2: Real UI action commits one queue entry and receipt; readback shows pending review and no authorization or recovery.

dimensions.score_0: Model or untrusted request can submit, authorize Scope, or cross task/tenant boundaries.
dimensions.score_1: Main path is guarded but one negative role/scope case is untested or ambiguous.
dimensions.score_2: Trusted SUPPORT owner confirmation is enforced; all frozen negative cases reject; Scope/Policy/Grant writes equal zero.

dimensions.score_0: Partial commits or duplicates are possible.
dimensions.score_1: Sequential duplicate is handled but crash/process/key-conflict proof is incomplete.
dimensions.score_2: Pre-commit failures roll back all rows; lost response and process races preserve one business identity and same receipt.

dimensions.score_0: Old evidence/draft can be accepted or correction/abort can be lost.
dimensions.score_1: Version checks exist but not in final Domain transaction or concurrency order is unproven.
dimensions.score_2: Same-connection transaction rechecks current S2 gate, draft, versions and TaskControl; write races serialize.

dimensions.score_0: UI claims approval, authorization, or repair without a trusted fact.
dimensions.score_1: UI labels are correct online but refresh/lost response recovery is unclear.
dimensions.score_2: Refresh, retry and follow-up consistently explain received/pending vs approved/authorized/recovered.

dimensions.score_0: Required prior suites or fresh evidence absent/failing.
dimensions.score_1: Some required regressions pass but full pytest, MCP, frontend or S1 evidence is incomplete.
dimensions.score_2: Fresh full pytest, historical M1/M2 regressions, real MCP stdio, build and S1 401-to-200 pass with commands/logs.

status_rules.PASS: Fresh primary evidence satisfies all criteria.
status_rules.FAIL: A tested criterion violates its frozen expected outcome or any hard safety gate fails.
status_rules.PARTIAL: Evidence exists but is incomplete or an explicitly non-blocking part did not run.
status_rules.NOT_RUN: No fresh execution evidence exists; docs or prior-stage logs do not count.
